title: Wire retrieval promotion gate into promotion path and harden it (VC-201-082)
goal: VC-201-082 refuted: evaluate_promotion is library-only — no production caller consults the verdict before promoting memory/index changes; the versioned-suite claim is unenforced (a stale candidate version promotes) and NaN metrics bypass both regression checks (an unmeasured suite reads as no regression). Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_082_mastery.rs.
